title: Why a kettle boils water
summary: An electric kettle turns electrical energy into heat at its base; the heat spreads through the water by conduction and convection until it boils.
learningObjectives: Explain how heat moves from the element into the water

sections.heading: The kettle clicks off by itself
sections.text: A kettle with a base and a spout; we assume an electric element.

sections.heading: A metal strip bends and flips the switch
sections.text: The element heats the water at the bottom, and warm water rises.

sections.heading: Metals grow when they warm
sections.text: Energy moves from hotter to cooler places.
